name: Breakfast with Santa at Dave & Buster's
paras: Destiny USA lists a Sunday morning Breakfast with Santa hosted by Dave & Buster's inside the mall. Tickets are sold through the Fever booking page linked from the mall's event listing.

The Dave & Buster's holiday page describes a pancake breakfast, a personal photo with Santa, kid-friendly crafts and early access to the store. It also mentions a $10 Power Card with 3 hours of unlimited video game play.
tip: Buy tickets ahead on the Fever page, since the mall listing points there for booking.
